nodes.label: bugfix Scope
nodes.rationale: Minimal depth, skeleton off, review cap advisory, 7 of 32 stages. Skips ideation entirely because there is no new product to discover; keeps reverse-engineering (understand what exists), requirements-analysis (state what fixed means), then code-generation and build-and-test. Keywords fix/bug/broken are word-boundary matched so debug and fixture do not trigger it.
